title: Localization & Globalization
description: Master multi-language support, cultural adaptation, and global deployment strategies for international PEGA applications

content.introduction: Global PEGA applications must support multiple languages, cultural preferences, and regional requirements. This lesson covers comprehensive localization strategies including language support, cultural adaptation, data formatting, and global deployment patterns.

sections.title: Multi-Language Architecture
sections.content: Design applications that support multiple languages through field value rules, translation catalogs, and dynamic language switching. Understand language detection and user preference management.

sections.title: Cultural Adaptation
sections.content: Adapt applications for different cultural contexts including date formats, number formats, color schemes, and cultural preferences. Understand cultural UX patterns and best practices.

sections.title: International Data Formats
sections.content: Handle international data formats including addresses, phone numbers, postal codes, and personal names across different regions and cultural contexts.

sections.title: Timezone and Currency Management
sections.content: Manage timezone differences and currency conversions across global applications. Understand timezone-aware scheduling and currency rate management.

sections.title: Global Deployment Strategies
sections.content: Deploy applications across multiple regions with considerations for data sovereignty, performance optimization, and regional compliance requirements.

sections.title: Testing and Quality Assurance
sections.content: Test localized applications across different languages, cultural contexts, and regional requirements. Understand localization testing strategies and quality assurance processes.
